newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CMAC Investment upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CMAC Investment upgraded.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Bruce Harding upgraded CMAC Investment Corp to buy from outperform.
-- Said the market should have fully discounted the pending legislation concerning mortgage insurance cancellations.

-- "We view the legislation as a positive public relations move for the industry, with little-to-no downside, since less than four percent of the outstanding insurance in force would be vulnerable to cancellation," Harding said in a summary report.
-- The stock was up one at 36-5/8.
